data.indexCnDesc: 中证红利指数选取100只现金股息率高、分红较为稳定，并具有一定规模及流动性的上市公司证券作为指数样本，以反映高股息率上市公司证券的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI Dividend Index selects the securities with high and steady cash dividend companies as constituents. The Index is to measure the performance of high and steady- cash dividend-paying companies in securities market.
